items.title: Jack Sheldon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: I had him in a small band with Art Pepper and Cat Anderson and Tricky Lofton and Dave Frishberg and Nick Ceroli and Joe Mondragon and Jack Marshall.

ctx.x: Yeah. We could always take off and do anything that happened. He didn’t like it if you took off too long, I think he got mad at Jake Hanna when he went with Supersax. And then Nick Ceroli started doing it.
